purpose: Encode native AlchLang-authored JSON construction plans while preserving original source observations. No Define decisions reside in the encoder.
generic_operations: object: create an empty JSON object at an exact target path
array: create an empty JSON array at an exact target path
copy: insert the exact decoded value from a bound source document and JSON pointer
text: insert a literal string selected by the authored model
uint: encode an exact nonnegative decimal UInt64 within the new-record safe integer bound
concat: encode explicitly supplied text/integer fragments as text; padding is explicit
DocumentText: copy a source-selected bound JSON string as an encoding fragment without routing its entire contents through a bounded native argument
DocumentUInt: encode a source-selected exact integer with source-selected width; no business expression or coercion
invariants: Every source document is read and bound by original bytes before any selector is evaluated.
No executable expression, conditional, schema inference, readiness decision, source promotion or permission is accepted by the encoder.
A target path may be written only once. Container parents must already exist.
Arrays append contiguous indexes; neither sparse arrays nor overwrite are accepted.
Original JSON fragments retain their values; original files remain separate exact-byte members.
The resulting document is strict deterministic new-record JSON, checked against an explicitly selected artifact schema before publication.
domain_ownership: Native AlchLang Mappings choose every field, selected source, target path, role, readiness value and authority statement. Rules/Operations validate observations before construction/publishing.
retirement_gate: Encoding primitive verification alone is insufficient to replace any complete Define workflow.
target_path_components: FieldParts: explicit text/integer encoding fragments, using the same bounded concat primitive
json_string_carrier: Literal JSON strings and text fragments include the empty string; they are distinct from nonempty identifiers and field names.
integer_wire_encoding: UIntText encodes an exact source integer as native decimal text without changing identifier/revision reference strings.
schema_nodes: Closed schema traversal examines schema nodes only; property names and const/enum literals remain data. Actual external schema resolution is refused.
